cohort: 159 term newborns with appropriate weights for gestational age, who were exclusively breast fed on the first day of life.
finding: Interstitial glucose levels in term, exclusively breastfed newborns declined until the sixth hour of life, then increased around the 20th hour, and remained stable until the end of the first day.
birth_weight: Appropriate weights for gestational age (specific weight not mentioned)
